headline: Revenue nearly triples, guidance raised, losses persist
summary_short: Revenue of $3,661M was up 168% y/y with operating income of $207M, but interest expense of $846M kept the net loss at $709M.
summary_long: Revenue rose by more than $1B sequentially as active power passed 1.7 GW. Adjusted operating margin reached 10%. Net interest expense of $846M and a $83M tax provision drove a GAAP net loss. Capex was $9.4B in the quarter. Full-year revenue guidance was raised to $13.0-13.3B and capex guidance to $37-39B. Backlog stood at about $132.5B.
confidence_notes: Press release (EX-99.1) read directly; the 8-K cover was a stub. Non-GAAP figures are company-defined. Guidance not written to the event shard (no sanctioned script).

drivers.explanation: Management calls it a breakout quarter, with revenue up more than $1B sequentially, supported by active power growing over 200 MW to above 1.7 GW.
Net interest expense of $846M versus $310M a year earlier, plus an $83M tax provision, outweighed operating income of $207M.
Funding comes from contract-backed financing, operating cash flow and about $9B of expected customer prepayments over the next three months.
